title: Rabbi Yehoshua ben Hyrcanus
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mishnah Sotah 5:5 says: “On that day Rabbi Yehoshua ben Hyrcanus expounded: Job served the Holy One, blessed be He, solely out of love.” Rabbi Yehoshua said: “Who will uncover the dust from your eyes, Rabban Yohanan ben Zakkai? Yehoshua, your student’s student…” (Rashi explains that he was Rabbi Akiva’s student.) He therefore lived during the dispute between Rabban Gamliel and Rabbi Yehoshua: Berakhot 28a explains that “on that day” refers to the day Rabban Gamliel was removed from the patriarchate.

notes.text: The expounder is Yehoshua ben Hyrcanus; the later exclamation is by another Yehoshua addressing his deceased teacher Rabban Yohanan ben Zakkai. Hyman’s chronology and Rashi attribution remain his argument.
